The result completely determines the Euclidean Hausdorff invariant for all convex cyclotomic indices, with exact maximizing corners and separate prime/dyadic rates, strengthening the non-sharp epsilon-loss estimate. The object and invariant are canonical and the result applies to infinite natural arithmetic index families; it is not an arbitrary finite slice.
